chapter: Freelancing, Miller and the girls' bands
title: Arranging Them There Eyes for Artie Shaw and Billie Holiday
summary: After Basie he arranged for Ina Ray Hutton, Glenn Miller and Artie Shaw, writing Them There Eyes for Billie Holiday.

bands.name: Ina Ray Hutton and Her Orchestra

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, now, after Basie, we have to go -- left 1938, scored regularly for Ida Ray Hutton, Glenn Miller, Jan Savitt, Artie Shaw.
Does all that follow right on from Basie?
Yeah. And when I went to Artie Shaw, first I made was Them There Eyes.
Them There Eyes, for Billie Holliday.
We went together, I went right over with her. I stayed about three or four weeks. She did, and when she left there she went to Basie and I went to Basie,
and began to write. Then I stayed over there a while and --
